      "content": "from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, REAL, DateTime, ForeignKey\nfrom sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nBase = declarative_base()\n\nclass User(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"users\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    username = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    full_name = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True)\n    phone = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Animal(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"animals\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    species = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    breed = Column(String)\n    age_years = Column(REAL)\n    gender = Column(String)\n    description = Column(Text)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"Available\")\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Applicant(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"applicants\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    full_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    email = Column(String, nullable=False, unique=True)\n    phone = Column(String)\n    home_type = Column(String)\n    existing_pets = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass AdoptionApplication(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"adoption_applications\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    animal_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"animals.id\"), nullable=False)\n    applicant_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"applicants.id\"), nullable=False)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"Pending\")\n    desired_meet_greet_date = Column(String)\n    created_by_user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"), nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass HomeCheck(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"home_checks\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    application_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"adoption_applications.id\"), nullable=False)\n    scheduled_date = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"Scheduled\")\n    notes = Column(Text)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)"

      "path": "schemas.py",
      "content": "from pydantic import BaseModel, Field\nfrom typing import Optional\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n\nclass ApplicantIn(BaseModel):\n    full_name: str\n    email: str\n    phone: str\n    home_type: str\n    existing_pets: str\n\n\nclass ApplicantOut(ApplicantIn):\n    id: int\n    created_at: datetime\n    updated_at: datetime\n\n    model_config = dict(from_attributes=True)\n\n\nclass AdoptionApplicationIn(BaseModel):\n    animal_id: int\n    applicant: ApplicantIn\n    desired_meet_greet_date: str\n    home_check_scheduled_date: str\n\n\nclass AdoptionApplicationOut(BaseModel):\n    id: int\n    animal_id: int\n    applicant_id: int\n    status: str\n    desired_meet_greet_date: str\n    created_by_user_id: int\n    created_at: datetime\n    updated_at: datetime\n\n    model_config = dict(from_attributes=True)\n\n\nclass HomeCheckIn(BaseModel):\n    application_id: int\n    scheduled_date: str\n    status: str = \"Scheduled\"\n    notes: Optional[str] = None\n\n\nclass HomeCheckOut(BaseModel):\n    id: int\n    application_id: int\n    scheduled_date: str\n    status: str\n    notes: Optional[str] = None\n    created_at: datetime\n    updated_at: datetime\n\n    model_config = dict(from_attributes=True)\n\n\nclass AdoptionApplicationWithHomeCheckResponse(BaseModel):\n    adoption_application: AdoptionApplicationOut\n    home_check: HomeCheckOut"
    },
    {
      "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom database import SessionLocal, get_db\nfrom models import AdoptionApplication, Applicant, HomeCheck, Animal, User\nfrom schemas import (\n    AdoptionApplicationIn,\n    AdoptionApplicationWithHomeCheckResponse,\n    HomeCheckIn,\n    ApplicantIn,\n)\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nrouter = APIRouter(tags=[\"AdoptionApplications\"])\n\n\ndef get_db_session():\n    db = SessionLocal()\n    try:\n        yield db\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n\n\n@router.post(\n    \"/adoption_applications\",\n    response_model=AdoptionApplicationWithHomeCheckResponse,\n    operation_id=\"create_adoption_application_with_home_check\",\n)\nasync def create_adoption_application_with_home_check(\n    payload: AdoptionApplicationIn,\n    current_user: User = Depends(lambda: None),  # Placeholder for auth\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db),\n):\n    # Validate animal availability\n    animal = db.query(Animal).filter(Animal.id == payload.animal_id).first()\n    if not animal:\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,\n            detail=\"Animal not found.\"\n        )\n    if animal.status != \"Available\":\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,\n            detail=\"Animal is not available for adoption.\"\n        )\n\n    # Check if applicant exists by email\n    applicant = db.query(Applicant).filter(Applicant.email == payload.applicant.email).first()\n    if not applicant:\n        # Create new applicant\n        applicant = Applicant(**payload.applicant.model_dump())\n        db.add(applicant)\n        db.flush()  # Get the ID without committing\n\n    # Create adoption application\n    adoption_app = AdoptionApplication(\n        animal_id=payload.animal_id,\n        applicant_id=applicant.id,\n        status=\"Pending Home Check\",\n        desired_meet_greet_date=payload.desired_meet_greet_date,\n        created_by_user_id=current_user.id if current_user else 1,  # Default fallback\n    )\n    db.add(adoption_app)\n    db.flush()  # Get the ID without committing\n\n    # Create home check\n    home_check = HomeCheck(\n        application_id=adoption_app.id,\n        scheduled_date=payload.home_check_scheduled_date,\n        status=\"Scheduled\",\n    )\n    db.add(home_check)\n\n    db.commit()\n\n    # Refresh objects to get all fields\n    db.refresh(adoption_app)\n    db.refresh(home_check)\n\n    return {\n        \"adoption_application\": adoption_app,\n        \"home_check\": home_check,\n    }"
    }
  ]
